en.description: Wenzhang Du is an independent researcher working on data mining, retrieval-augmented generation, and trustworthy machine learning.
en.role: Data mining, RAG & trustworthy machine learning
heroStatement: When do model answers follow the evidence?
I use controlled comparisons to find out.
en.heroIntro: I study how systems find relevant evidence and how to evaluate the factual reliability of the answers they generate.
en.degree: B.Eng. in Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence
en.aboutLead: My research starts with a simple question: how do we know an AI system is behaving reliably?
aboutParagraphs: I hold a B.Eng. in Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence. My recent work examines how the choice of retrieved evidence affects answers in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
My research background also includes model auditing, language model safety, efficient deep learning, computer vision, and remote sensing.
For graduate research, I want to develop evaluations that distinguish answer accuracy from reliable evidence use.
en.researchIntro: My current work centers on multi-hop questions, whose answers often depend on facts spread across several passages.

research.title: Data mining & retrieval
research.description: I study how ranking and document structure affect whether retrieval finds the facts needed to answer multi-hop questions.

research.title: Evidence use in RAG
research.description: I examine how evidence selection and presentation shape answers, and whether models respond when relevant facts change.

research.title: Trustworthy ML
research.description: I use factuality audits, paired comparisons, and uncertainty estimates to identify failures that aggregate scores can miss.

en.publicationIntro: Conference publications and accepted papers, spanning trustworthy learning, evaluation, and applied AI.

awards.title: Research travel support

skills.text: Deep learning, trustworthy AI, LLM safety evaluation, AI agent auditing, hallucination and risk analysis

skills.title: Statistical evaluation
skills.text: Paired tests, bootstrap confidence intervals, multi-seed experiments, metric design, uncertainty reporting

skills.title: Applied machine learning
skills.text: Computer vision, remote sensing, model compression, quantization-aware learning, edge-aware ML

en.contactIntro: Interested in trustworthy AI, evaluation, or graduate research? I would be glad to exchange ideas.

zh.description: 独立研究者 Wenzhang Du 的个人学术主页。研究方向包括数据挖掘、检索增强生成与可信机器学习。
zh.role: 数据挖掘、检索增强生成与可信机器学习
zh.heroEyebrow: 独立研究者 · 个人学术主页
heroStatement: 模型在什么情况下会依据证据作答？
我用受控对照实验来检验。
zh.heroIntro: 我关注系统如何检索相关证据，以及如何评估模型生成的回答是否符合事实。
zh.degree: 计算机工程与人工智能学士学位
zh.aboutLead: 我的研究始于一个朴素的问题：我们如何知道一个人工智能系统的行为是可靠的？
aboutParagraphs: 我拥有计算机工程与人工智能学士学位。近期研究关注检索增强生成（RAG）中的证据选择，以及不同证据组合如何影响回答。
我的研究背景还包括模型审计、大语言模型安全、高效深度学习、计算机视觉和遥感。
下一步，我希望分别衡量答案的正确性和模型使用证据的可靠性。
zh.researchIntro: 我目前主要关注多跳问答，其中答案往往依赖分散在多个段落中的事实。

research.title: 数据挖掘与信息检索
research.description: 研究文档结构和排序方法如何影响多跳问题的证据检索。

research.title: RAG 中的证据使用
research.description: 研究证据的选择与呈现如何影响生成答案，以及模型能否随关键事实的变化调整回答。

research.title: 可信机器学习
research.description: 通过事实性审计、配对比较和不确定性估计，找出总体分数可能掩盖的失效案例。

zh.publicationIntro: 会议论文与已录用论文，涵盖可信学习、实证评估与人工智能应用。
